entries.symptom: gas_head PhaseWindowTCN regime reports near-zero N2 explanatory power while H2/CH4/CO2 remain nonzero in the same diagnostic comparison
entries.hypothesis: N2 is not learnable from the available sensors
entries.discriminator: hold encoder, data, split, scaler and loss fixed; compare gas_head, raw4 and softmax100, then check free-component parity
entries.root_cause: within the documented gas_head regime, N2 has no independent output degree of freedom and its error inherits free-component errors
entries.residual_ceiling: numeric information ceiling for N2 remains unknown until matched raw4/softmax100 comparison is closed
entries.scope: hydrogen_ng gas_head output parameterization; not a global N2 impossibility claim
entries.corrective_action: treat output heads as separate algorithms and close the controlled head sweep before changing the encoder
entries.stop_condition: do not declare N2 unlearnable from gas_head-only evidence
entries.general_fusion_impact: A0 must freeze output semantics and closure policy before architecture search

entries.symptom: historical syngas result reports and output bundles use 128 timesteps, while current model configs use target_timesteps=512
entries.hypothesis: 128-step baseline metrics can be cited as current 512-step performance
entries.discriminator: require matching manifest, target_timesteps, split, scaler, config and result_ref for every metric claim
entries.root_cause: confirmed version boundary after the sequence-length migration
entries.residual_ceiling: no valid 512-step performance inference from 128-step evidence
entries.scope: syngas historical baseline and ablation suite
entries.corrective_action: keep sg4-formal-128 deprecated historical and create a new sg4-formal-512 experiment record
entries.stop_condition: block any 128-to-512 metric transfer or ranking
entries.general_fusion_impact: data_version and temporal contract are mandatory fields for current mainline evidence

entries.symptom: historical PatchTST fp16 AMP path produced NaN or non-convergent behavior
entries.discriminator: rerun the same 128-step architecture under validated fp32 and compare artifact validity before interpreting model quality
entries.root_cause: the documented failure belongs to the fp16 execution variant; fp32 recovery separates numerical failure from architecture behavior
entries.residual_ceiling: no architectural conclusion is allowed from the failed fp16 run
entries.corrective_action: record AMP mode in the experiment identity and validate metrics plus loss finiteness
entries.stop_condition: do not label PatchTST as a model failure without the fp32 control
entries.general_fusion_impact: numerical settings and artifact validity belong in the run manifest, not in informal notes

entries.symptom: a Windows LSTM process returned a nonzero exit code even though metrics artifacts were complete
entries.hypothesis: the model run failed and all metrics are invalid
entries.discriminator: validate checkpoint, metrics completeness, final-step consistency and process exit separately
entries.root_cause: documented engineering false negative or process teardown, not automatically a scientific model failure
entries.residual_ceiling: the affected seed remains invalid until per-run artifact checks are complete
entries.corrective_action: store process_exit, artifact_validity and scientific_status as separate fields
entries.stop_condition: never infer scientific failure from exit code alone
entries.general_fusion_impact: formal evidence needs an artifact-level acceptance rule

entries.symptom: end-to-end waveform routes show poor O2 behavior while calibrated observed-feature baselines are substantially stronger in the historical tunnel protocol
entries.hypothesis: a larger end-to-end network will solve the failure
entries.discriminator: separate absolute TOF representation error, calibration/quality features, pooling behavior and Fisher rank before changing capacity
entries.root_cause: multiple supported layers: early representation loses absolute timing, deployment-relevant calibration/quality is missing, pooling cannot express the L-sweep slope, and single-carrier information has rank limitations
entries.residual_ceiling: single-carrier information and deployment observability impose a task-specific ceiling; exact ceiling depends on the frozen feature contract
entries.corrective_action: run information and representation parity checks first; retain B7 baseline-plus-residual as a bounded structural pattern
entries.stop_condition: do not launch a bigger generic waveform model as the first response
entries.general_fusion_impact: A0 must expose observable timing/quality assumptions and permit an information audit before model comparison

entries.symptom: E1 peak representation has large timing error; frame-level recovery does not automatically restore sequence-level performance
entries.hypothesis: frame-level peak accuracy is sufficient for deployment sequence prediction
entries.discriminator: compare E1, E1r and E1d with sequence parity, calibration, correlation, PSR and SNR features
entries.root_cause: early representation loses absolute TOF and sequence-level slope information; E1d-SB is a separate observed representation with additional calibration and quality terms
entries.residual_ceiling: single-carrier and feature-quality limits remain after representation repair
entries.corrective_action: treat the full sequence representation and quality features as the unit of comparison
entries.stop_condition: do not promote a frame-only representation from frame metrics
entries.general_fusion_impact: sensor encoders must preserve deployment-relevant absolute timing and quality, not only local peaks

entries.symptom: MRS-EI closure reached a hash-verified freeze but semantic verdict remained not_passed and C3 restoration was not approved
entries.hypothesis: a complete freeze can be reported as a successful algorithm result
entries.discriminator: keep evidence completeness, freeze verdict and semantic pass/fail as separate fields
entries.root_cause: the frozen C2 evidence did not satisfy the semantic acceptance gate; this is a protocol closure, not an implementation success
entries.residual_ceiling: no deployment uncertainty claim is authorized beyond the closed C2 evidence
entries.corrective_action: close the route and require an explicitly approved new protocol for reopening
entries.stop_condition: do not silently continue into C3 or call the freeze passed
entries.general_fusion_impact: formal review must separate artifact completeness from scientific acceptance

entries.symptom: documented hard suppression increased clean error and triggered on a large fraction of clean/degraded cases
entries.hypothesis: thresholded modality suppression improves robustness whenever ErrorNet predicts high error
entries.discriminator: calibrate predicted error on clean and physically recomputed perturbation sets, then compare clean cost and degradation benefit
entries.root_cause: threshold/maxShift policy was not calibrated for deployment and operated on an incompletely specified standardized-space diagnostic
entries.residual_ceiling: robustness benefit is unknown; clean degradation is already observed in scope
entries.corrective_action: make calibration and clean-cost gate prerequisites for any suppression route
entries.stop_condition: do not enable hard suppression by training loss or threshold intuition alone
entries.general_fusion_impact: uncertainty-driven routing requires explicit calibration and deployment-cost metrics

entries.symptom: documented perturbations were applied after scaling, so they represent standardized-space changes rather than physical sensor perturbations
entries.hypothesis: the perturbation level directly represents physical sensor degradation
entries.discriminator: recompute sensor outputs from physical nuisance changes, then apply the same scaler and compare with standardized-space perturbation
entries.root_cause: confirmed mismatch between perturbation implementation and physical interpretation
entries.residual_ceiling: no physical robustness conclusion is valid from the standardized-only perturbation
entries.corrective_action: separate standardized sensitivity tests from physically recomputed degradation tests
entries.stop_condition: do not label standardized level 0.11 as a physical sensor fault level
entries.general_fusion_impact: nuisance and degradation variables need explicit units and generation semantics in the task contract

entries.symptom: documented ErrorNet correlation with actual modal errors was near zero or negative
entries.hypothesis: jointly predicted error is a reliable routing signal
entries.discriminator: pre-register calibration, rank correlation, component-wise reliability and an independent perturbation discriminator
entries.root_cause: mechanism not confirmed; the current evidence is insufficient to separate target leakage, calibration failure and perturbation mismatch
entries.residual_ceiling: dynamic weighting benefit cannot be claimed until error prediction is calibrated
entries.corrective_action: park dynamic routing and recover/rerun the missing artifacts under a calibrated protocol
entries.stop_condition: do not use ErrorNet weights as a default fusion policy
entries.general_fusion_impact: learned routing requires a separately validated auxiliary target and reliability gate

entries.symptom: all seven P3 candidate routes reached terminal rejection at the frozen G3-4 gate
entries.hypothesis: candidate rejection proves the general fusion problem is infeasible
entries.discriminator: restrict the conclusion to the frozen GIB cells, candidates, splits, seeds and metric gate
entries.root_cause: confirmed candidate-set failure under the pre-registered gate; no single universal model root cause is asserted
entries.residual_ceiling: the gate bounds those candidate routes only; future information contracts are not evaluated
entries.corrective_action: return to P1/P2 only with an explicit new information hypothesis and new pre-registered gate
entries.stop_condition: do not open P4 or expand candidate search from the same failed premise
entries.general_fusion_impact: information gates should precede broad architecture search and preserve negative controls

entries.symptom: three head metrics files exist, but training.log records a formal dataset FileNotFoundError and the saved model_config uses waveform_int16_scale=32767 while the current PhaseWindowTCN entry accepts waveform_adc_scale
entries.hypothesis: the saved metrics are directly attributable to a successful run of the current head-sweep entrypoint
entries.discriminator: recover the formal data root and replay with a history_audit prefix, then compare run_config, model_config, checkpoint hashes and raw predictions
entries.root_cause: the current tree contains a provenance/config contract conflict between the recorded execution and the saved head artifacts
entries.residual_ceiling: head ranking, N2 performance and any information-ceiling interpretation are not supported by these metrics
entries.corrective_action: downgrade all three head rows to E1 and recover or replay the artifacts under the current waveform_adc_scale contract
entries.stop_condition: do not use the three saved metrics as an algorithm conclusion before provenance is closed
entries.general_fusion_impact: a formal result must bind entrypoint, model kwargs, data root, target transform, split, seed and output hash

entries.symptom: gas_head and softmax100 metrics contain exactly equal evaluation objects despite different output_mode values and different checkpoint hashes
entries.hypothesis: the identical evaluation objects arise from a genuine head behavior rather than duplicated or stale evaluation output
entries.discriminator: inspect per-sample raw predictions and checkpoint provenance after a successful matched replay; verify the evaluator consumes the selected head output
entries.root_cause: unknown; the anomaly cannot be separated from the broader artifact/config conflict
entries.residual_ceiling: no head comparison or causal explanation can be drawn from the equal evaluation objects
entries.scope: hydrogen_ng gas_head versus softmax100 saved metrics
entries.corrective_action: retain the anomaly as a discriminator for artifact recovery; compare raw predictions, evaluator inputs and checkpoint loading
entries.stop_condition: do not interpret equality as evidence of equivalent parameterizations
entries.general_fusion_impact: result integrity checks must include output-head identity and per-sample prediction provenance
